findings.detail: Runs the upstream batch formula, structure, and class annotation operation and emits records ready for integration rather than assembling the requested master feature table.
Produces upstream per-feature SIRIUS formulas, structures, and CANOPUS classes for later integration rather than consolidating the named results into the requested feature table.
Combines GNPS node data and CANOPUS predictions into per-feature consensus classes and sample-level profiles but omits the formula and fingerprint master-table join.
Reranks existing SIRIUS molecular-formula candidates with ZODIAC across a dataset rather than performing the whole SIRIUS-plus-ZODIAC formula stage.
Detects LC-MS/MS features and merges fragmentation spectra per feature for SIRIUS, but does not supply the requested aligned quantification table and explicit SIRIUS MGF export.
